column1: # derivation: §3.11: a SEMI join returns each left row that has a match at
# most once, however many right rows it matches. lid 1 (lk = 1) matches rid
# 5; lid 2 and 3 (lk = 2) match rid 1 and 2 but appear once each; lid 4's
# NULL key matches nothing (§3.1), not even rid 3's NULL; lid 5 (lk = 3) has
# no match. Types: the left columns only (§3.11), as scanned.
